title: Bridge button
description: Flat, almost-square buttons with a small up-right arrow: a sky-blue fill that dims slightly on hover, a white button with a 1px ink outline that turns near-white, a see-through outlined one that takes a faint grey wash, and a plain text link whose underline grows from the left on hover.
notes: fills fade over 0.25s ease; the link underline grows over 0.4s on an ease-out-quart curve
the solid hover darkens the primary token with brightness(0.9), so it follows any theme
name: bridge-button

props.name: href
props.description: renders a link when set, a button otherwise

props.name: variant
props.description:
solid: sky fill, a touch darker on hover · outline: page-coloured with an ink outline ·
ghost: see-through with an ink outline (over backdrops, e.g. the header) · link: plain
text whose underline grows on hover

props.name: arrow
props.description: show the small up-right arrow after the label (on by default)

props.name: type
props.description: the button's type when it isn't a link
